card.head: Your money stays on your computer.
card.sub: What Groundwork keeps private, and how - on a made-up sample household.

scenes.say: Groundwork 2.0 keeps your money on your computer. Here's how, on a made-up sample household.
The AI runs inside Groundwork, on your own computer. There's no cloud option, and every page still works with the AI turned off.
The AI log shows every request made to the AI, exactly as it was sent and as it came back. All of it ran on this computer.
Backups can be protected with a password and a twenty-four word recovery key. A protected backup can't be opened by anyone who finds the file.
Voice is off until you turn it on. What you say is recognised on this computer, and never sent anywhere or kept.
Your data is yours to export at any time, and health spending is left out unless you tick the box.

card.kicker: No account · No cloud AI · No telemetry
card.head: One door out, and it's watched.
card.sub: Every request the app makes goes through one place in its code, and Groundwork's own tests fail if anything tries another.
